stimulus.body: Algorithms: a case involving 2288 steps. Consider how selection sort governs the situation.

questions.stem: Which property of selection sort matters for 2288 steps?

options.text: Inserts each item into a sorted prefix

questions.explanation: selection sort: Selection sort repeatedly finds the smallest remaining element and swaps it into place, using quadratic comparisons. With 2288 steps in view, that principle distinguishes the correct choice; every other option rests on a specific misconception.
questions.hint: What does it pick on each pass?
